channel.title: Paul Tinker AI log
channel.description: A working log of designing and building digital products with AI: design systems rebuilt in code, products shipped end to end, and what changes when AI is part of the system.

item.title: Kavvi: a renewals app, designed and shipped end to end
item.description: A renewals app for families: design system, iPhone and Android apps, docs, Storybook and a live site. I made the decisions; AI did the building.

item.title: Governance in an AI-native world
item.description: Governance in an AI-native world: an agent that decides before it builds, a front door anyone in the company can use, and a person who still makes the call.

item.title: Edgey: where the design work goes when building takes a day
item.description: An idea I'd had for years, taken all the way to Google Play: app, site, brand and backend. I designed it and directed the build, and the first time the whole product was mine.

item.title: Two design systems, out of design and into code
item.description: Out of design artifacts and into code: the two largest design systems I've worked on rebuilt as real front-ends, prototypes running on them, and a product idea built from scratch.

item.title: Two design systems rebuilt as design artifacts
item.description: Two design systems rebuilt as interactive design artifacts, four product experiences on top of them, and audits that run while you work.

item.title: Rebuilding my portfolio homepage in Claude Design
item.description: Rebuilt my portfolio homepage in Claude Design and pushed it live: 3D assets, motion, and how little it now costs to try a direction.

item.title: Bridge: an AI-native product and design system
item.description: An AI-native product and design system: a multi-brand e-commerce prototype, designed and built through prompts.
